Pharzites
FAR-zites
n. pl. (the family of Pharez, numbered among the tribes of Israel)
Hebrew ha-Partsi, the Pharzite, a patronymic from Pharez, from the proper name Pharez, a breach or a breaking forth; named once, Numbers 26:20.

Definition · Webster 1828 · Scriptures · Corruption · Roots · Usage · Related

Biblical Definition

The Pharzites are the family of Pharez, the elder of Tamar's twins: “And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites” (Numbers 26:20). The name was given at the birth, when the midwife had bound a scarlet thread on the hand that came out first and the other child broke through ahead of him. Pharez means a breach. From this family came Hezron, Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz, Obed, Jesse and David, and from David the Lord Jesus Christ. In the census of Numbers 26 none of that is visible; the Pharzites are simply one family among the five of Judah, counted with the rest so that the land might be apportioned. “Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names” (Numbers 26:53). The royal line is in the list without any mark on it.

Webster 1828 Definition

Webster (1828): Pharzites, the patronymic of the family of Pharez, numbered in the tribe of Judah; Numbers 26:20.

expand to see more

Hebrew ha-Partsi, used collectively of the family.

A patronymic from the proper name Pharez, from the proper name Pharez, a breach or a breaking forth.

It occurs once in this form in the Authorized Version, Numbers 26:20.

The family is reckoned in the tribe of Judah.

The numbering was taken expressly for the dividing of the inheritance.

Key Scripture

Num 26:20 — "And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites."

Num 26:53 — "Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names."

Num 26:55 — "Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit."

Gen 46:12 — "And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul."

Modern Corruption

A census treats every household alike; the family through which Messiah would come is counted in Numbers 26 with no distinction whatever.

expand to see more

It would be natural to expect the messianic line to be flagged in the registers, and it never is. The Pharzites appear between the Shelanites and the Zarhites, numbered and apportioned, with nothing to indicate that the covenant promise to Judah ran through them. The distinction was real and entirely hidden.

This entry faces no significant postmodern redefinition. The principle to recover is that God works His largest purposes without advertisement, through families that look like every other family in the list. “Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit” (Numbers 26:55). The breach that gave Pharez his name became, in time, the line of the King.
